big_picture.summary_en: Reports indicate US lawmakers are advancing new restrictions on advanced AI chip exports to China, with Nvidia and AMD actively lobbying the Trump administration to intervene. This developing development adds direct pressure on semiconductor names while the market paradox of cooler inflation prints versus still-rising yields keeps equities caught between lower rate-path odds and higher discount rates.

big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX sits at 16.34, a calm reading that suggests investors are not pricing in immediate panic despite the trade headline.

big_picture.rates_note_en: 10-year Treasury yield at 5.29% remains elevated and continues to act as a headwind for growth stocks by raising discount rates.
